root_cause: The R53 BC eval branch built the controller with fresh_controller(seed) alone and compared against the registered BC parameter identity. The registered BC_POST parameters come from the BC checkpoint state (r45_bc.load_bc_controller_state) applied to the same-seed fresh factory, exactly as R45's training injection and R46's model-only preflight do. The checkpoint load step was missing from the R53 harness.
